variants.contract: Check only whether the tool name appears in the initial plan; no parameter, effect-role, provenance, or evidence checks.
Instantiate the totalized call against the authority envelope and emit exactly one call-level match/mismatch; no per-field decision, no per-target expansion, no role-specific repair.
Every official schema parameter is a security_field with role untyped_argument; unknown parameters fail closed.
Counterfactually registered security_fields, field_roles and effect_kind; list targets expanded per descriptor semantics; non-security fields never block authority.
V3 with roles rotated by a fixed seed; executed only if a semantic influence test shows roles change behavior, else non_applicable.
